about.title: About me
about.text: I'm Virginia, a junior backend developer based in Barcelona. I work remotely for Ethix, where I build features with NestJS, TypeScript and PostgreSQL, integrate AI models and write E2E tests with Playwright. Before that I worked in technical support at Sequra, a fintech, which showed me how bugs affect real users. I like understanding problems end to end: from the database to what people see on screen.

items.title: Junior Developer (Backend)
items.date: Ethix · Remote from Barcelona · Feb 2026 - present
tasks: Built the context layer that feeds an LLM with business data, so a chatbot can answer users about the status of their cases.
Implemented data isolation with Row Level Security in PostgreSQL through a NestJS middleware.
Implemented providers to integrate different AI models in the backend.
Built an end-to-end status filter and worked on the frontend unifying styles.
Designed an E2E test suite with Playwright covering the whole application.

proyects.title: Projects
proyects.summary-cientifics: Educational games platform with a leaderboard
proyects.desc-cientifics: Team project: educational games platform with a leaderboard (PHP, MySQL). I built the login with sessions, hashed passwords and PDO prepared statements, and the waste-collecting game in JavaScript: collision detection, lives system, progressive difficulty and score submission to the leaderboard.
proyects.desc-organizen: Collaborative project management tool. PHP backend with endpoints consumed from JavaScript via fetch, MySQL prepared statements and a drag-and-drop task board.
proyects.desc-chillgig: Team project: platform connecting musicians with venues (Laravel, Vue 3, MySQL, Docker). I designed the relational database (15 tables) and built the REST API with filters and messaging, the login with Laravel authentication and a Mapbox map integration.
proyects.desc-yogamotion: Yoga class management platform. I built a REST API in Laravel with authentication, event CRUD and enrollment, and an interface with Vue 3 and Bootstrap. MySQL database with Eloquent and a Docker setup.
